lines.text: The Lord sends a message against Jacob, and Ephraim and Samaria proudly vow to rebuild with finished stone.
The LORD raises up the foes of Rezin, and Aram from the east and Egypt from the west devour Israel.
The LORD will cut off head and tail in a single day; the tail is the priest who teaches lies.
The land is scorched by the wrath of the LORD of Hosts, and Manasseh and Ephraim together turn against Judah.
Woe to those who make oppressive decrees against the poor; they will crouch among captives or fall among the slain.
